newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-National Foods seeks trading halt.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-National Foods seeks trading halt.

text.p: Directors of National Foods Ltd on Friday said they had requested a trading halt be placed on the company's shares pending the release of an announcement.
The Australian Financial Review reported on Friday the company's managing director, Max Ould, was to unveil a major initiative targeted at National Foods' underlying cost base.
Ould foreshadowed a review of assets in October, shortly after he replaced former managing director, Graham Reaney.
National Foods is 9.12 percent owned by Singapore-based conglomerate Camerlin Pte ltd.
